text.title: A/B Testing Procedure
text.summary: 6-step procedure from pre-registered design through the runtime to the signed ship/kill decision.

step.name: pre-register-the-design
step.input: Product question + baseline conversion rate + the metric inventory
step.action: Write the plan before any code: hypothesis, primary metric, guardrail metrics, named segments, MDE, and the sample size computed at 80% power / 95% significance. Set the minimum end date at one full business cycle. Freeze it.
step.output: Pre-registration plan; `design` block of the experiment-run artefact
step.decision-gate: If the required sample size cannot be reached inside a reasonable window at current traffic, stop here — the experiment cannot answer the question, and running it anyway produces a number that looks like an answer.

step.name: wire-deterministic-bucket
step.action: Implement bucket(user_id) = (int.from_bytes(blake2b((user_id+experiment_id+salt).encode(), digest_size=8).digest(), "big") % 100) < threshold. Verify in unit tests that the same user always lands in the same arm.
step.output: bucket function deployed to web + mobile + server
step.decision-gate: If two surfaces use different hash inputs, fail sticky-across-surfaces and rework.

step.name: emit-exposure
step.action: Fire exposure event the first time a user hits the gate. Use idempotent event keys.
step.output: exposure events flowing to stats engine

step.name: emit-conversion
step.action: Fire conversion event ONLY for users with a prior exposure within the experiment window. Conversions without prior exposure are dropped.
step.output: conversion events flowing to stats engine

step.name: analyse
step.action: Compute z-test for proportions; build Wilson 95% CI on lift; compute SRM chi-square p-value against expected_split. Run `templates/analyzer.py`.
step.decision-gate: srm_chi_square_p < 0.001 → decision=invalid-srm; investigate bucket leak before any other interpretation.

step.name: decide
step.input: Result block + sample size achieved + guardrail readings + the pre-registration
step.action: Sample size < planned, or elapsed time under one business cycle → decision=invalid-underpowered. CI spans zero → decision=kill or extend. CI strictly > 0, SRM clean, no guardrail regression, and the effect clears the practical-significance floor → decision=ship, pending the named human's sign-off. Record the artefact and close the flag.
step.decision-gate: Any guardrail regression blocks the ship regardless of the primary metric. Segment findings not named in the pre-registration are reported as exploratory, never as the result.
